findings: The chrono candidate introduced a floating-duration template compile error on its final allowed repair; compiler feedback arrived after the two-repair budget was exhausted.

The integer candidate inverted explicit protected-test expected=false/actual=true evidence despite complete current helper/test definitions, then treated its earlier hypothesis as established fact. Its final proposal intentionally used an invalid empty path; the controller rejected it.

The structured diagnostic adapter incorrectly collected GoogleTest 'Which is' values for both operands under actual. Raw assertion text and complete test source were still correct. Remove that inference; preserve operand/value pairs verbatim without guessing expected/actual roles.

changes: Add an assertion-grounded repair prompt as a separate version while preserving all existing repair and investigation prompts byte for byte. Require the explanation to distinguish observed values from expected values and resolve contradictions against current assertions/protected tests before editing.

Correct the shared diagnostic adapter for ALL three V7 arms: only explicit actual XML/labels populate actual; GoogleTest 'Which is' operands retain their named expressions in raw text. The V7 two-repair control therefore includes this common evidence correction relative to V6; do not attribute that cross-phase difference solely to model variability.
Measure extra repair capacity independently from the new prompt. No native oracle, case mutation, split, source retrieval or publication-gate change.

A separate operations-only grading correction distinguishes correct invalid-evidence rejection from stale failure reproduction; it does not alter the repair workflow or original raw operational grades.

shared.native_oracle: Unchanged V6 duration10/fmt12 trusted checks, full original baseline retention, protected tests/configurations, final rebase/retest and tested/pushed/PR head agreement.
shared.diagnostics: Corrected explicit-value extraction shared across all three arms; no inferred expected/actual roles from GoogleTest operand order.

ordering: Interleave all three arms within fmt, strings and systems groups. Isolated ephemeral model calls; latency remains descriptive under concurrent load.
independent_review: Review every native publication against protected tests, current source, complete executed baseline identities and publication receipts; preserve native grades and annotate confirmed semantic regressions separately.

selection.eligible: Only completed24-case arms in this registered V7 comparison, with no pending independent publication review.
ranking: Most native publications without independently confirmed semantic contract regressions.
Fewest total actual live Luna investigation plus repair calls across all24 trials, including failures.
Lowest total measured trial latency; stable lexicographic arm ID only for an exact final tie.
selection.cost_limits: Expanded arms have larger maximum model and native-build budgets; do not attribute gains to prompting alone. Equal-resource comparison is expanded-budget-v7 versus assertion-grounded-v7.

holdout.prerequisite: Complete all72 development trials and reviews; freeze selected recipe, source/input hashes and exact held-out execution plan before first holdout call.
holdout.prior_holdout_plan: holdout-v6.json remains preserved and was never executed. A V7 plan will be registered after selection.
holdout.baseline: Original repair-v1, medium,60000 characters,no inspections,unstructured,no definition reads,two repairs,two stable native baselines, same unchanged V6 oracle.

claim_limits: Finite development repetitions do not establish a guaranteed repair rate.
The45 corpus cases are synthetic injected regressions in two pinned real C++ projects, not historical incident resolutions.
Only gpt-6-luna is evaluated; Qwen and real on-premise services remain unmeasured.
Mechanical/native replay controls are zero-inference checks and are not extra live model evaluations.
